notes.title: TechnoAlpin Pack Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35797361/19c86095fc7be251769d2a80521eaa3b3f855c0f.jpg[/img]

The feature-update for the Winter Resort Simulator add-on just got released and includes some of your requested features. 

Here’s a list of added features: 
- Summer covers added! Summer covers can now be toggled with the "I" key. When active, the functionality of the snowcannon is limited depending on the type (tower, lift, arm). 
- Toggleable flashing light! The flashing light can now be toggled with the "P" key. When active, the light is flashing continously, independent of the current state of the snow cannon. 
- Toggleable night light! The night light can now be toggled with the "O" key. When activating a snow cannon at night, the light will activate itself too. 
- Terrain alignment of mobile snowcannons! By pressing the "G" key, the support legs of the mobile snowcannons position themself so the snowcannon is horizontally aligned. With the "T" key, the support legs move back to their default position. 

Some features might not show up at the top left, due to the limit of 6 hints up there. If you are unsure about some keys, check the key bindings in your settings. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: The new Truck & Logistics Simulator is coming soon!
notes.content:
Are you tired of driving trucks “only”? You toy with the idea of starting your own logistics company and wish for more vehicles for loading/transporting/unloading in a simulation? Then this simulation game might be the right one for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/873840/Truck_and_Logistics_Simulator/

The upcoming TRUCK & LOGISTICS SIMULATOR ([i]Release: June 23, 2020[/i]) enables you to take control of the logistics chain right from the start, optionally in single or multiplayer mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28135608/887b590010be9ad116cda48d1d06df94b688a286.jpg[/img]

Start your own logistics company and use more than [b]20 different vehicles[/b] to master complex loading tasks and deliver the freight to your customers properly. You can choose your vehicle from trucks (semi/rigid), vans, platform trucks, pickups, cars & monster trucks.

[previewyoutube=9A1PI-GZgA4;full][/previewyoutube]

Play together! In the [b]multiplayer mode[/b] you can create convoys with your friends and carry out deliveries together.

Master your way from level to level and collect experiences and money. But beware, if you damage the cargo or disregard the traffic rules, you will receive penalty points. 

Make smart, economical decisions, word hard and lead your company to great success!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Truck and Logistics Simulator will be released as an Early Access Version on June 23, 2020 on STEAM. The price will be €19.95/$19.99. 

Add to your wish list now and get notified about the release automatically!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/873840/Truck_and_Logistics_Simulator/

notes.title: Patch 5 out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35797361/6aedd5c17839f3a4fc110a0f3c39a6ab9d5b48d3.png[/img]

And here it is – Winter Resort Simulator’s next patch! Amongst others, you can look forward to share maps via the Steam Workshop. It’s worth stopping by! Have a nice weekend! 😊🚠

Here’s the complete changelog:
- Maps can now be added and uploaded to Workshop!
- Custom slope maps supported!
- Bugfix in tutorial mission
- "Gipfeltreff" is now labelled correctly everywhere
- Modding SDK will be updated in the next few days
- Some prefabs fixed and others added
- Minor bugfix with TGD garaging

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35797361/47a255f8dadb88cf4cb01b189aeafa32366878a6.png[/img]

A new patch is online! From now on you can use the Steam Workshop for your mods – simply create your own content and share it with the community or discover interesting mods by other users and download them right away.
Interesting information on that: We are also planning a mod contest in this context. But more information coming soon. 😉

Changelog:
- Modding SDK now includes PB600, snow cannon, and snowfox!
- Save games can be renamed and deleted!
- Added Steam Workshop with in-game upload!
- Fixed several gameplay bugs
- Tutorials can be stopped
- Deliveries will be saved correctly
- Fixed skiing-mode bug
- UI scaling for aspect ratio 5:4, 32:9, and 48:9
- Cable cars can be recolored in the savegame
- Several visual improvements, amongst others support number labels
- Completed slope-labelling objects
- Equipped AI cars with lights and indicators
- and many more! (e.g. 3S collision, weather forecast, slopes/lifts in the investments menu, ropeway-editor, …)

As always, you can find the complete changelog on our Discord: https://discord.gg/k5vHkrp

Have fun! :mountain_cableway:

notes.title: Patch 3 now officially released!
notes.content:
Following issues have been fixed:

- Modding SDK added to the game's install files!
- More than 300 objects can be placed using the ingame editor!
- Fixed several bugs regarding tutorials.
- Also fixed some bugs concerning automatic operation of ropeways.
- Improved parking control to avoid carriers getting stuck.
- Some improvements to the ingame editor, especially to terrain editing (replace) and building ropeways.
- Slope hardening/freezing improved
- and many more! (e.g. loans, ropeway shutdowns, switching vehicles, light touchscreen, ...)

Have a nice time in-game and happy new year!

notes.title: Winter Resort Simulator Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35797361/5320bd56b4a90cd04f42c7451c3ca29e70870ae5.png[/img]

Even after its release, we are working on further improving your gaming experience in Winter Resort Simulator. So here are the first patchnotes for you!

Following issues have been fixed:

- Game doesn't crash when ski lifts, slopes or facilities are closed
- Snow cannons work properly now!
- Default joystick layout removed
- Fixed a bug in the controls menu which caused the game to crash 
- Some LOD levels revised
- 8-seated chairlift will take more than 4 persons now

- no more lags any 2-4 seconds
- Revised input mapping in ingame editor
- Added a terrain grass texture for summer games (and for snowmaking)
- Fixed various issues regarding savegames.
- Fixed the issue of disappearing objects after loading a game
- Fixed a bug because of which the rope winch couldn't be disconnected
- Recent savegames and in-game messages are now always displayed on top
- Fixed some minor details regarding skiers
- and many more!
